channel.title: Apache SkyWalking – Cloud Native
channel.description: Recent cloud native posts from Apache SkyWalking

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · The AI Assistant: Ask Your Observability Data in Plain Language
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Horizon UI's new AI Assistant answers questions about your live system with the same charts, topology and tables as the UI — read-only, permission-scoped, and running on a cost-efficient model you bring yourself.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · AI Assistant：用日常语言查询你的可观测性数据
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 新增的 AI Assistant 可以用和 UI 相同的图表、拓扑和表格回答运行中系统的问题；它只读、按权限返回结果，并运行在你自己接入的高性价比模型上。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 13/17: Platform & Cluster Introspection
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 13 of the Meet Horizon UI series: three read-only introspection surfaces that turn the lens on the backend itself — Cluster Status (is OAP healthy, across which ports), OAP Configuration (the effective runtime config), and Data Retention (how long each class of data lives, including BanyanDB's hot/warm/cold lifecycle).

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 14/17: Access Control & Security
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 14 of the Meet Horizon UI series: Horizon's own access control — server-enforced RBAC with four roles, local and LDAP/AD authentication, an append-only audit log, an LDAP-only break-glass hatch, and five themes. All of it lives in Horizon's BFF and works the same on any OAP version.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 15/17: Customization — Config-Driven Layer Templates
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 15 of the Meet Horizon UI series: the whole console is driven by templates you can edit. Open any layer or overview as a template, change its widgets, components, and labels in a local draft, preview it, and publish it to OAP for the whole org — with diff-before-push and export/import.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 13/17：平台与集群自检
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十三篇：Platform monitoring 下的三个只读入口，用来查看 OAP 集群是否健康、实际运行配置是什么，以及各类数据会保留多久，包括 BanyanDB 的 hot/warm/cold 生命周期。

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 14/17：访问控制与安全
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十四篇：Horizon 自己的访问控制体系，包括由服务端强制执行的四级 RBAC、本地与 LDAP/AD 认证、append-only audit log、仅在 LDAP 故障时可用的 break-glass 入口，以及五套内置主题。所有逻辑都在 Horizon BFF 中实现，对任何 OAP 版本都一致。

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 15/17：用模板定制控制台
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十五篇：整个控制台都由可编辑模板驱动。你可以把任意 layer 或 overview 打开成模板，在本地草稿里调整组件、widget 和文案，预览后发布到 OAP 给整个组织使用，并在发布前查看差异，也可以导出和导入。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 10/17: Alarms & Incident Triage
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 10 of the Meet Horizon UI series: the incident-centric active-alarms surface — re-fires merged into one row, the MQE snapshot that fired a rule replayed on a single chart, and the same incident model carried across the topbar badge, dashboards, and the 3D map.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 10/17：告警与 Incident 排查
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第十篇：活跃告警不再按事件堆叠，而是按 incident 归并；触发规则时的 MQE 指标快照可以直接回放，同一套 incident 模型也会出现在顶栏、仪表盘和 3D 地图里。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 7/17: The Log Explorer
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 7 of the Meet Horizon UI series: two log surfaces — a stored, indexed, trace-correlated log stream with a level histogram, and an on-demand live tail of a Kubernetes pod's container logs.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 7/17：日志探索器
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第七篇：两类日志视图，一种查看已采集、已索引、可关联 Trace 的存储日志流，并提供按级别堆叠的直方图；另一种按需实时查看 Kubernetes pod 的容器输出。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 5/17: The 3D Infrastructure Map
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 5 of the Meet Horizon UI series: a single WebGL view of your whole deployment — every layer's services as cubes stacked on tiers, with live traffic, alarm beacons, and the calls between them.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 6/17: The Trace Explorer
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 6 of the Meet Horizon UI series: a per-layer distributed-trace explorer — staged conditions, a duration-distribution chart you can box-select, three ways to read one trace, and a Zipkin tab beside the native one.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 5/17：3D 基础设施地图
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第五篇：用一个 WebGL 场景把整个部署放到同一张 3D 地图里，把各个 Layer 的服务渲染成立方体，并同时展示实时流量、告警和调用关系。

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · 6/17：Trace 探索器
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 系列第六篇：位于 Layer 内的分布式 Trace 探索器：先配置条件再查询，在时延分布图上框选异常 Trace，并用瀑布图、调用树和统计表阅读同一条 Trace。

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 1/17: SkyWalking's New Observability Console
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Introducing Apache SkyWalking Horizon UI — the next-generation web UI. A greenfield rewrite on the same OAP backend that you can observe, operate, govern, and customize, starting with a sidebar that mirrors your whole estate.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 2/17: Dashboards That Adapt — MQE, Smart Widgets, and Numbers Humans Can Read
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 2 of the Horizon UI series: how its dashboards are built from MQE expressions, hide the widgets that don't apply to the entity in front of you (skipping their queries on the server), and render OK instead of 1 and 45.1k instead of 4.51e4.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 3/17: Topology & Service Dependency
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 3 of the Meet Horizon UI series: one template-driven topology engine that repaints for every layer, a filter to cut the noise, drill-down from a call into instances, the endpoint-dependency graph, and the cross-layer Smartscape overlay.

item.title: Meet Horizon UI · 4/17: The Deployment Tab & BanyanDB Self-Observability
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Part 4 of the Meet Horizon UI series: the Deployment tab turns the topology map inward to show one clustered service's own instances, and BanyanDB is modeled as the role- and tier-aware cluster it is — SkyWalking finally watching its own database the way it watches everything else.
